gateway_stripe.credentials.publishableKe: Stripe Dashboard -> Developers -> API keys. Copy the Publishable key for the same mode you use here (test or live).
gateway_stripe.credentials.secretKey.hel: Stripe Dashboard -> Developers -> API keys. Use the Secret key from the same mode. In live mode Stripe may only show it once, so reveal or rotate it there if needed.
gateway_stripe.credentials.webhookSecret: For local development, expose your app through a public HTTPS tunnel and use that public URL in Stripe.
Create or open your Stripe webhook endpoint in Workbench.
Set the destination URL to your public Open Mercato URL plus /api/payment_gateways/webhook/stripe.
Subscribe to the payment and dispute events listed below.
Reveal the endpoint signing secret and paste the whsec_... value into the Webhook Signing Secret field in Integrations.
Save the Stripe integration credentials, then test the payment flow again.
Configure a Stripe webhook endpoint so payment status changes, refunds, failed payments, and disputes stay synchronized with Open Mercato.
Use the Stripe endpoint signing secret that starts with whsec_, not your API key.
